## Summary

Describe the user problem and the resulting behavior. For copy changes, explain which real action or state the wording represents.

## Related issue

<!-- e.g. Closes #123. For anything beyond a small fix, please open an issue first. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] One focused, logical change
- [ ] Changed behavior verified in the dashboard or CLI; steps and results included
- [ ] `npm run pack:dry-run` passes
- [ ] Docs and visible controls describe the same behavior
- [ ] Protocol fields, event markers and error recovery remain compatible
- [ ] Verification artifacts, research data and logs remain outside the distribution
- [ ] Actual verification platforms and unverified cases are stated
- [ ] I agree my contribution is licensed under Apache-2.0
